notes.title: Update 0.11.1.4 is Live!
notes.notes:
New Battle UI  
Keep it clean.  We've implemented a more minimalist approach to our battle UI that shows you what you need in the heat of battle and nothing more.

 New Tutorial 
We've revamped the tutorial to focus on core game mechanics - solving and building - and less on UI navigation.

 Bug Fixes 
Variant replay works properly now.
Escape build mode Key sliding bugs have been fixed.
Other small bug fixes.

notes.title: Update 0.11.05 is Live!
notes.notes:
New Feature
Training Interface-lift
We've made Training simpler and easier to follow for new players with a new UI and flow.  We'll carry this interface over to Relik Quests which are coming soon!

Bug Fixes

 Fixed false invalid design error on Escape
 Fixed Variant design when re-entering design mode
 Matches properly adapted to tiebreak rounds
 Several other minor fixes

notes.title: 0.10.1.8 Relik Update
notes.notes:
Features
Added queue time to UI
The chat box is easier to see and is automatically selected when you open your faction panel

Minor Tweaks
A faction creator can chat without faction members (is anyone here?)
Bots no longer miss the first input in mirror mode
You can tell which tab you have selected in Faction info panel now
Bot AFK check plays a sound when it pops up

Bug Fixes
Client won't try to send error reports that may crash the client
No longer see the "Donate" button on your own faction piece request
Faction Join button no longer visible if Faction is full.

notes.title: 0.10.1.5 Relik Update
notes.notes:
We're back to rapid updates again now that real-time is live!

Improvements

Waiting for an opponent to finish viewing a higher level puzzle's "initial playback" happens before your playback now instead of after.
 "Lit" duration of Sequence inputs reduced so fast inputs don't blend together.
 Popup notification fade curve improved


Bug Fixes

 Joining a battle after disconnecting from a bot match works properly now.


Coming Soon!

 See both players' puzzle levels during the match
 Improved (ie slower) replay speed
 More bug fixes

notes.title: 0.9.10 is Live - Major Update!
notes.notes:
Weekly Leagues 
Join leagues composed of up to 50 players in your trophy range.  Battle every week for new glory and epic rewards.

Themes 
We're pleased to finally release these stunning new visuals for Relik.  Enjoy Relik in a variety of beautiful environments.

Feedback and Bug Report Forms 
Let us know what you think - good, bad, or broken.  All from the convenience of the in-game settings menu.

Improved PAC Visuals 
Along with new themes come beautifully redesigned Pick a Cards (including standard theme PACs)

League Names 
Leagues now have names instead of numbers.

Bug Fixes 
- Completely redesigned Runes system should mean old bugs fixed and less bugs in the future.
- Trying to avenge an attack while watching a maze replay doesn't break stuff anymore.
- Various other minor bug fixes.

Happy solving!

-the Iron 27 Team

notes.title: 0.9.8 Live! (Major Update)
notes.notes:
Check out all the new features in our first Season 2 update below.

Three Maze Designs!
Players now unlock a new maze design slot at Maze level 5 and 10 for a total of three maze designs.  One of your maze designs is chosen at random when your Relik is attacked.  Memorizing your designs is now three times harder for attackers.

Maze Replays!
Watch attackers get lost in your maze.  Just pull up your defense history in Battle Logs and click 'Maze Replay' on the match details panel.

Note: maze replays will not start recording until this update, so only recent defenses will be recorded.

Revenge Attacks!
You asked for it, we made it. Want to exact revenge on someone who defeated your Relik?  Pull up the match in your Battle Logs and click Revenge to attack their Relik.

Note: players with an active shield cannot be attacked.

Polish and Bug Fixes
Welcome Panel added for new players (full tutorial coming soon).
 Improved the layout of Match Details panel.
 Fixed a puzzle selection bug
 Other small bug fixes.

notes.title: 0.9.5.1 Update
notes.notes:
Maze Token Acceleration 2.0
Just like 0.9.4, The maze token now increases in speed if it has not reached an intersection (turns are not intersections) in 5 tiles.  Unlike 0.9.4, this speed is not fully reset on maze edges.  The token slows for the edge and rotation only.

Balance
To adjust for acceleration above, all maze solve times have been reduced by roughly 8%.

 Bug Fixes  
- Even more double-click bug fixes.

Happy Solving!

- the Iron 27 Team
